blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: World models enable embodied agents to anticipate action consequences, yet jointly modeling locomotion and manipulation across diverse embodiments remains challenging due to heterogeneous action spaces and limited multimodal supervision. We present Ropedia W0, the first egocentric loco-manipulation world foundation model spanning humans and robots with diverse embodiments. We curate Xp-Data, comprising 10k hours of egocentric human data and 3k hours of robot data with unified multimodal annotations and systematic quality control. A unified kinematic representation encodes locomotion through camera poses and manipulation through projected skeletons, with robot skeletons combining embodiment-specific forward kinematics with extensive manual keypoint annotation and correction. We also introduce Xp-Teleop, a long-horizon loco-manipulation benchmark based on high-quality dexterous humanoid teleoperation data. Evaluations demonstrate state-of-the-art performance across five cross-embodiment benchmarks (DreamDojo, $Ψ_0$, $ω$-HOME, Xp-Teleop, and AgiBot) and on held-out human egocentric video, from zero-shot inference to few-shot and full-data post-training. Scaling human pre-training data improves performance on both human and robot evaluations. After distillation, our model supports real-time, minute-long rollouts, enabling live VR interaction. Applications in policy evaluation, model-based planning, and world-action modeling further demonstrate the model's utility for embodied decision-making.
blocks.zh: 世界模式使体现的代理人能够预见到行动的后果,但是由于行动空间各异和多式联运监督有限,联合模拟不同表现形式的运动和操纵仍然具有挑战性。 我们介绍Ropedia W0, 这是第一个以自我为中心 游戏操控世界的基础模型, 覆盖了人类和机器人, 并有着不同的化身。 我们管理Xp-Data,包括10k小时以自负为中心的人类数据和3k小时机器人数据,并附有统一的多模式说明和系统质量控制. 统一的动能表现编码通过相机起姿和通过投影骨架进行操纵来进行运动,机器人骨架结合了特异性前动能和广泛的手动键点注释和校正. 我们还引入了Xp-Teleop,一个基于高品质的去克氏人造电动操作数据的长视离子操纵基准. 评估显示,在五个交叉表现基准( " DreamDojo " 、 " $0美元 " 、 " $-HOME " 、 " Xp-Teleop " 和 " AgiBot " )和以人为自负为中心、从零镜头推论到数镜头和完整数据培训的视频上,都取得了最新业绩。 扩大人类培训前数据可提高人和机器人评价的性能。 蒸馏后,我们的模型支持实时,分长的推出,允许活式VR交互. 在政策评价、基于模型的规划和世界行动模式方面的应用进一步表明该模式对体现的决策的效用。

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: World models predict how environments evolve in response to actions [ 42 , 14 ] and support decision-making by imagining future outcomes [ 43 ] , giving them considerable potential in embodied intelligence. However, most existing models [ 119 , 122 , 4 ] focus on fixed-base, gripper-based manipulation, leaving locomotion-induced viewpoint changes and dexterous hand–object interactions largely underexplored. Moreover, generalizing across embodiments poses a further challenge. DreamDojo [ 34 ] replaces latent-action conditioning with robot-specific actions during post-training, and Cosmos3 [ 1 ] relies on domain-specific action projections despite a shared backbone; both therefore require a dedicated control interface or additional adaptation for each new embodiment. Therefore, jointly modeling locomotion and manipulation while seamlessly generalizing across diverse embodiments remains an open problem.
blocks.zh: 世界模型预测环境如何因应行动[42、14]而演变,并通过设想未来的结果[43]来支持决策,使其在体现的智能中具有相当大的潜力。 然而,大多数现有的模型[119、122、4]都侧重于固定基数,以握手为主的操纵,使得运动引发的观点变化和自相残杀的手-物体相互作用基本上没有得到充分利用。 此外,将各种表现概括起来,也是一个挑战。 DreamDojo [34] 在训练后用机器人特定动作来取代潜伏的动作条件,而Cosmos3 [1] 尽管有共同的主干线,但依赖于特定域的行动预测;因此,两者都需要一个专门的控制界面或对每一个新的化身进行额外的改造. 因此,联合模拟运动和操纵,同时无缝地概括各种表现,仍然是一个公开的问题。

blocks.en: Learning a generalizable world model hinges on large-scale, high-quality egocentric video paired with rich multimodal annotations, such as camera trajectories, hand motion, and task descriptions. While robot demonstrations across diverse tasks and embodiments remain expensive to collect, egocentric human video offers an abundant and complementary source of experience on how humans navigate and interact with their surroundings. However, existing public egocentric datasets [ 39 , 40 , 46 , 113 , 27 , 2 , 78 ] frequently suffer from incomplete or unreliable annotations. Specifically, many lack metric camera trajectories, provide noisy or missing hand poses, and adopt heterogeneous formats that hinder joint training. Furthermore, the scale of these datasets remains limited, falling short of the data required to train a generalizable world model.
blocks.zh: 学习通俗世界模型取决于大规模、高品质的自我中心视频,并配以丰富的多模式说明,如相机轨迹、手动和任务说明。 虽然机器人在各种任务和表现上的演示仍然昂贵,收集起来,但以自我为中心的人类视频提供了丰富和互补的经验来源,说明人类如何导航和与周围环境互动。 然而,现有的以公众自负为中心的数据集[39、40、46、113、27、2、78]常常受到不完整或不可靠的说明。 具体地说,许多人缺乏标准相机轨迹,提供吵闹或缺失的手姿,并采用阻碍联合培训的不同格式。 此外,这些数据集的规模仍然有限,没有达到培训可通用的世界模型所需的数据。

blocks.en: To address these challenges, we present Ropedia W0 , a unified egocentric world model that scales learning from human and robot videos for cross-embodiment loco-manipulation. We curate Xp-Data , comprising 10k hours of egocentric human data and 3k hours of robot data, with unified geometric, kinematic, and semantic annotations produced through automated processing, manual robot-keypoint annotation, and quality checks. To connect human motion and robot actions, we introduce a shared explicit kinematic representation that combines metric camera poses for locomotion-induced viewpoint changes with projected skeletons for manipulation. The skeletons combine human pose annotations with robot forward kinematics (FK) and manually annotated or corrected robot keypoints, preserving embodiment-specific structure in an image-aligned format. This conditioning interface remains consistent across human pre-training, human–robot mid-training, and optional post-training. We further introduce Xp-Teleop , a humanoid teleoperation benchmark for evaluating long-horizon prediction during locomotion and dexterous manipulation.
blocks.zh: 为了应对这些挑战,我们提出了Ropedia W0, 一个统一的以自我为中心的世界模型, 它从人类和机器人的视频中吸取教训, 用于交叉化的游戏。 我们管理Xp-Data, 包括10k小时的自负式人类数据和3k小时的机器人数据, 并有统一的几何、动能和语义说明, 通过自动化处理、人工机器人键点注释以及质量检查。 为了将人类运动和机器人行动联系起来,我们引入了一种共同的明显的运动表现,结合了用于运动所引发的视角变化的公制相机和用于操纵的预测骨架。 骨架结合了人类的姿势说明和机器人前向动能(FK)以及手动附加说明或修正的机器人键点,以图像相通的格式保留了特有的化身结构. 这种调节接口在人类预训、人-机器人中训和可选的后训之间依然一致。 我们进一步引入了Xp-Teleop,这是用于在运动和自控操作期间评估长视距预测的人体远程操作基准。

blocks.en: We evaluate Ropedia W0 on five cross-embodiment benchmarks (DreamDojo, Ψ 0 \Psi_{0} , ω \omega -HOME, Xp-Teleop, and AgiBot), alongside held-out human egocentric video. Results demonstrate strong predictive performance across embodiments and post-training budgets, including zero-shot transfer and data-efficient adaptation. Scaling analyses show that increasing the amount of human pre-training data improves both prediction on human videos and transfer to robots. Ablations establish the complementary roles of camera and skeleton conditioning, while distillation enables real-time, minute-long rollouts and live VR interaction across embodiments. Downstream experiments further demonstrate accurate policy ranking, improved trajectory planning, and more robust action learning in simulation and on real robots.
blocks.zh: 我们评价Ropedia W0的五个交叉表现基准(DreamDojo, ^0\Psi_{0}, ^ omega-HOME, Xp-Teleop和AgiBot), 结果表明,在各种表现和培训后预算中,包括零射入门和数据高效的适应,都取得了强有力的预测性业绩。 放大分析显示,增加人类培训前数据的数量既能改善人类视频上的预测,又能向机器人转移. 分解确立了相机和骨架调节的互补作用,而分解则能够使实时,分秒长的展开和活生生的VR相互作用跨越了活体. 下游实验进一步展现出准确的政策排名,改进了轨迹规划,在模拟和真实机器人上更能扎实地进行动作学习.

blocks.en: Our contributions are threefold: • We introduce Ropedia W0 , which, to the best of our knowledge, is the first unified egocentric world model for cross-embodiment loco-manipulation. A shared explicit kinematic representation of camera poses and projected skeletons enables scalable learning from human and robot videos. • We design a human-in-the-loop pipeline that unifies collection, annotation, and quality checks, including extensive manual robot-keypoint annotation and correction of inaccurate FK projections. Consequently, we build Xp-Data , comprising over 10k hours of human data and 3k hours of robot data in a shared schema. • Extensive experiments show that Ropedia W0 achieves state-of-the-art cross-embodiment prediction, including on our long-horizon loco-manipulation Xp-Teleop benchmark. We further show that Ropedia W0’s performance scales with human data and demonstrate applications in real-time interaction, policy evaluation, model-based planning, and world–action modeling.
blocks.zh: • 我们的贡献有三: 我们介绍Ropedia W0, 据我们所知, 这是第一个统一的自我中心世界模式, 交叉化的游戏。 相机的外观和投射骨架具有共同的明显动能,从而能够从人和机器人视频中进行可扩展的学习。 我们设计了一条人行走的管道,统一收集、注释和质量检查,包括大量的人工机器人键点注释和纠正不准确的FK预测。 因此,我们构建了Xp-Data, 包括10多小时的人类数据和3k小时的机器人数据在一个共享的计划中。 · 广泛的实验表明,Ropedia W0实现了最新水平的交叉化预测,包括在我们的长距离遥控Xp-Teleop基准上。 我们进一步表明,Ropedia W0的性能尺度是人类数据,并展示了实时互动、政策评价、模型规划和世界行动模型的应用。

blocks.en: 2 Related Work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en:
Robotic video world models. Early world models learned compact latent dynamics for control [ 42 , 43 ] ; large video generators yield interactive worlds [ 14 , 88 , 89 , 75 , 24 , 74 ] and ego-motion-controlled driving simulators [ 47 , 98 , 35 ] .
Distillation and self-rollout training convert video generators into causal few-step models [ 130 , 50 , 26 , 72 ] , augmented with long-horizon memory [ 45 , 100 ] . Robotic world models learn video dynamics from robot trajectories [ 124 , 142 , 55 , 67 , 41 , 139 , 122 , 44 ] , often adapting a video foundation model [ 3 , 108 ] .
Numerical action tokens require embodiment-specific encoding [ 111 , 41 ] ; latent actions inferred from video [ 14 , 128 , 36 , 38 , 34 ] make unlabeled footage usable, but may entangle actions with other visual changes [ 133 ] ; spatially aligned renderings provide explicit geometric conditioning [ 55 , 122 , 126 , 115 , 119 ] .
Cross-embodiment models use embodiment-specific action heads, projections, or adaptation [ 111 , 34 , 1 ] , a single rendered interface [ 115 , 119 ] , or factorized human-to-robot recomposition [ 22 ] . The last, AnyWorld [ 22 ] , recomposes human interactions into robot experiences but conditions on source human skeletons rather than target-robot kinematics and is evaluated mainly on manipulation, leaving sustained loco-manipulation untested.
Ego-motion is also studied in navigation and driving [ 8 , 47 ] and in egocentric predictors conditioned on or jointly modeling full-body pose [ 7 , 87 , 121 ] .
Ropedia W0 uses an explicit kinematic interface to unify loco-manipulation across humans, gripper robots, and dexterous humanoids.
blocks.zh:
机器人视频世界模型. 早期世界模型学习了控制[42,43]的紧凑潜在动力;大型视频发电机产生互动世界[14,88,89,75,24,74]和自控运动控制驱动模拟器[47,98,35].
蒸发和自滚培训将视频发电机转换为因果的几步模型[130,50,26,72],并辅以长相内存[45,100]. 机器人世界模型从机器人轨迹学视频动力学[124,142,55,67,41,139,122,44],经常改编视频基础模型[3,108].
数字动作符号需要具体化编码[111,41];从视频[14,128,36,38,34]推断出的潜在动作使得无标签的镜头可以使用,但可能将动作与其它视觉变化相缠 [133];空间对接渲染提供了明确的几何条件[55,122,126,115,119].
交叉化模型使用特有化能动作头,预测,或适应[111,34,1],单个渲染的接口[115,119],或将人对机器人再分解[22]. 最后一部"AnyWorld [22]"将人类的相互作用重新编为机器人体验,但来源人类骨架上的条件而不是目标机器人动能,并主要通过操纵来评价,使得持续的loco操纵没有经过测试.
ego-motion也在导航和驾驶[8,47]和自负式预测器中被研究,其条件为或共同模拟全身姿势[7,87,121].
罗佩迪亚 W0使用一个明显的动能界面,统一了横跨人类,抓取机器人,和可脱落的活体.

blocks.en:
Human and robot datasets. Large egocentric human collections cover daily and skilled activity [ 39 , 27 , 40 ] ; pose-annotated collections add body or hand pose [ 82 , 78 , 46 , 92 ] , and portable rigs bring hand pose into everyday scenes [ 109 , 76 ] .
Aggregated and in-the-wild demonstrations [ 86 , 58 , 107 , 30 , 118 ] and large teleoperation sets [ 15 ] provide robot actions, calibrated views and task captions in varying combinations, with substantial coverage of tabletop arm and gripper manipulation; humanoid sets include locomotion or dexterous hands [ 138 , 101 , 94 , 117 , 65 ] .
Evaluation data include held-out robot video clips [ 142 , 34 , 119 ] , multimodal world-model benchmarks [ 1 ] , and benchmarks measuring visual quality, physical consistency or embodied utility [ 132 , 84 ] .
Xp-Data unifies annotations for public human and robot data and self-collected egocentric video; Xp-Teleop benchmarks long-horizon dexterous humanoid loco-manipulation with robot-native kinematics.
blocks.zh:
人与机器人数据集. 以自我为中心的大型人类收藏包括日常和熟练的活动[39、27、40];附加说明的收藏增加身体或手姿 [82、78、46、92],便携式钻机将手姿带入日常场景[109、76]。
组合式和内接式演示[86、58、107、30、118]和大型远程操作集[15]提供机器人动作、校准视图和任务标题,组合式不同,大量覆盖了平顶臂和握手操控;人相机集包括了运动或脱节手 [138、101、94、117、65]

blocks.en:
Policy evaluation, planning, and learning. Policy evaluation extends real-to-sim protocols [ 62 ] to video world models through recorded-action rollouts [ 142 , 64 , 119 ] or closed-loop policy interaction [ 95 , 41 , 103 , 102 ] .
For planning, world models score or refine action proposals using predicted outcomes [ 93 , 28 , 53 , 34 ] , in pixel or learned latent spaces [ 140 , 5 ] , and support reinforcement fine-tuning and synthetic data generation [ 143 , 56 , 61 , 120 , 54 ] .
Vision-language-action models map observations and language to actions using pretrained vision-language models [ 13 , 59 , 12 , 52 , 11 ] , increasingly trained with human video [ 128 , 16 , 15 , 123 , 80 , 57 , 117 ] , whereas world–action models couple future video or latent-state prediction with action learning [ 21 , 141 , 48 , 111 , 67 , 127 , 1 , 9 , 81 , 65 , 112 , 131 ] .
Ropedia W0 supports these applications in Sec. 6 ; for world–action modeling, we transfer its pretrained video backbone to initialize such a model rather than adding a dedicated action head.
blocks.zh:
政策评价、规划和学习。 政策评价通过录制动作推出[142,64,119]或闭路政策互动[95,41,103,102],将真到真协议[62]扩展至视频世界模式.
就规划而言,世界模型利用预测结果[93、28、53、34],在像素或所学到的潜在空间[140、5]中评分或完善行动建议,并支持强化微调和合成数据生成[143、56、61、120、54]。
展望语言-行动模型将观察和语言映射到使用经过预先训练的视觉语言模型的行动[13,59,12,52,11],越来越多地接受人类视频培训[128,16,15,123,80,57,117],而世界-行动模型将未来的视频或潜在状态预测与行动学习结合[21,141,48,111,67,127,1,9,81,65,112,131].
Ropedia W0在Sec. 6中支持这些应用; 对于世界-行动模型,我们转移它经过预先训练的视频主干线来初始化这样的模型,而不是添加一个专门的动作头.

blocks.en: Figure 2: Xp-Data curation pipeline. Heterogeneous human and robot recordings pass through five stages. (1) Data sources : 14 public human egocentric datasets, 6,000 h of in-house four-camera recordings, and 13 public robot datasets. (2) Video filtering removes low-quality or task-irrelevant clips with a vision-language model. (3) Multimodal annotation produces geometry (metric camera poses via SLAM and DA3 [ 69 ] ), kinematics (human hands via WiLoR [ 91 ] and MANO [ 96 ] , robot keypoints via URDF forward kinematics, manual annotation, and correction), and semantics (hierarchical task, subtask, and atomic-action captions). (4) Quality check verifies completeness, correctness, and cross-modal consistency, pairing automated checks with a caption cascade (Gemini [ 25 ] annotation, Qwen [ 6 ] verification, and human review). (5) Training-clip construction cuts quality-verified subtasks into standardized 81-frame, 640 × 480 640\times 480 , 16 fps multimodal clips, yielding the unified cross-embodiment corpus.

(3)多式注释产生几何(通过SLAM和DA3[69]),动能(人类手通过WiLOR[91]和MANO[96]),机器人键通过URDF前动能,手动注释和校正)和语义(分级任务,子任务和原子动作标题). (4) 质量检查核实完整性、正确性和跨模式一致性,将自动检查与标题级联(Gemini[25]注释、Quen[6]核查和人文审查)相配。 (5)培训-剪接施工将质量核实的子任务剪接为标准化的81帧,640×480640\times 480,16fps多式剪接,产生统一的交叉浮雕.

blocks.en: 3 Data
blocks.zh: 3 数据

blocks.en: Learning cross-embodiment loco-manipulation requires data that captures both viewpoint changes and manipulator motion under a shared annotation scheme. However, existing datasets [ 39 , 40 , 46 , 113 , 27 , 2 , 78 , 31 , 29 , 60 , 77 , 37 , 92 , 97 , 15 , 58 , 30 , 135 , 101 , 11 , 33 , 10 , 63 , 85 , 49 , 105 , 138 ] fall short of this requirement: most lack essential geometric information such as camera poses, and their hand annotations are often noisy or inaccurate, making them insufficient for training a general-purpose world model.
blocks.zh: 学习交叉化的loco-manipulation需要数据,在共享的注解方案下既能捕捉观点变化又能掌握操纵器运动. 然而,现有的数据集[39,40,46,113,27,2,78,31,29,60,77,37,92,97,15,58,30,135,101,11,33,10,63,85,49,105,138]都未达到这一要求:大多数缺乏相机姿势等基本几何信息,其手语说明往往很吵或者不准确,不足以训练通用世界模型.

blocks.en: To address this gap, our human-in-the-loop data pipeline unifies collection, multimodal annotation, and quality checks (Fig. 2 ). We re-annotate public human and robot recordings, with substantial manual robot-keypoint annotation and correction, and collect over 6,000 hours of in-house multi-view video with a four-fisheye-camera rig. This yields Xp-Data, over 10k human and 3k robot training hours with synchronized RGB, camera trajectories, manipulator skeletons, and captions; wrist poses and wide-FOV skeletons are included where available. Our Xp-Teleop benchmark provides about one held-out hour of long-horizon dexterous humanoid loco-manipulation, recorded in the same schema with an off-the-shelf rig [ 104 ] (Sec. A.2 ).

blocks.en: Data sources. Xp-Data comprises human and robot data. The human collection combines 14 public egocentric datasets [ 39 , 40 , 46 , 113 , 27 , 2 , 78 , 31 , 29 , 60 , 77 , 37 , 92 , 97 ] with over 6,000 hours of in-house recordings captured using a device equipped with four fisheye cameras, covering diverse daily activities and object interactions. The robot collection draws from 13 public datasets [ 15 , 58 , 30 , 135 , 101 , 11 , 33 , 10 , 63 , 85 , 49 , 105 , 138 ] spanning parallel grippers and dexterous hands. Together, these collections provide complementary coverage of activities, camera motion, and manipulator kinematics.
blocks.zh: 数据来源. Xp-Data包含人和机器人数据. 人类的收集结合了14个以公众自负为中心的数据集[39,40,46,113,27,2,78,31,29,60,77,37,92,97],并使用配备了4个鱼眼相机的装置捕获了超过6000小时的内部录音,涵盖了各种日常活动和物体相互作用. 机器人的收集取自13个公共数据集[15,58,30,135,101,11,33,10,63,85,49,105,138],横跨平行的抓取手和放纵的手. 这些藏品共同提供了活动、相机运动和操纵动能的补充报道。

blocks.en: Video filtering. We filter the raw recordings for visual quality and task relevance before annotation. A vision-language model screens each segment for severe blur, poor or uneven illumination, over- and under-exposure, and excessive camera jitter, removing clips unsuitable for reliable geometric and kinematic annotation. We discard segments with neither camera motion nor visible hands.
blocks.zh: 视频过滤. 我们过滤原始录音 以获取视觉质量 和任务关联性 在注释前。 一个视觉语言模型屏蔽每个段,以显示严重模糊、差或不均匀的发光、过度和接触不足以及相机过度焦躁,取出不适于可靠几何和动能注释的片段。 我们丢弃片段,既无相机运动也无能见的手。

blocks.en: Multimodal annotation. We annotate geometry, kinematics, and semantics in a unified format. For geometry, we obtain camera intrinsics and metric trajectories from available calibration or estimate them using our in-house SLAM pipeline or DA3 [ 69 ] . Grounding DINO [ 73 ] identifies dynamic regions, such as hands and people, for exclusion from camera-trajectory consistency checks. For human kinematics, we project WiLoR-reconstructed [ 91 ] MANO [ 96 ] keypoints into images. Captions describe hands, objects, and interactions at task, subtask, and atomic-action levels.
blocks.zh: 多式联运注释。 我们用统一的格式来注释几何、动能和语义。 就几何学而言,我们从现有的校准中获取相机内在和测量轨迹,或使用我们内部的SLAM管道或DA3[69]进行估计。 地平线DINO[73]确定动态区域,如手和人,排除于相机-弹射一致性检查之外. 对于人类动能学,我们预测WiLOR重构[91]MANO [96]键入图像. 说明描述在任务,子任务,和原子活性水平上的手,物体,和相互作用.

blocks.en: Robot keypoint annotation and correction. Direct FK projections often misalign with the hands and grippers in the public robot recordings we process, and many releases lack reliable camera calibration. We therefore invest substantial effort in manually annotating image-space keypoints and correcting inaccurate projections. FK provides initial estimates where joint states and calibration are available; manual annotations supply or refine the image-aligned robot skeletons used for training. Wrist poses are derived through FK where available.
blocks.zh: 机器人键位注释与修正. 直接的FK预测常常与我们处理的公开机器人录音中的手和抓取器错相,许多发布缺乏可靠的相机校正. 因此,我们投入大量努力,人工说明图像空间的关键点并纠正不准确的预测。 FK提供有联合状态和校正的初始估计;人工说明提供或完善用于训练的图像相通机器人骨架. 手腕姿势通过可用的FK得到.

blocks.en: Quality checks. We verify annotation completeness, correctness, and cross-modal consistency. Camera trajectories are checked for depth-reprojection consistency and temporal smoothness, following [ 110 ] . Human hand annotations are checked both geometrically and semantically: projected 3D keypoints are compared against independent 2D detections from MediaPipe [ 79 ] and a fine-tuned MMPose [ 83 ] model, while a vision-language model flags false detections and hands belonging to other people. Robot keypoints are cross-checked by two detectors fine-tuned on our manually annotated robot-hand data, which recover missed hands and remove duplicate or misaligned detections. Qwen [ 6 ] verifies Gemini [ 25 ] captions, with human review resolving discrepancies. Human spot checks across modalities identify systematic annotation errors.
blocks.zh: 质检. 我们核实注释的完整性、正确性和跨模式一致性。 相机轨迹在[110]后检查深度再预测的一致性和时间平滑性。 人手说明书同时被几何和分解地检查:预测出3D键点被比作MediaPipe的独立2D检测[79]和一个微调的MMPose[83]模型,而一个视觉-语言模型会标出属于其他人的假检测和手. 机器人键点由两个探测器在手动附加注释的机器人手数据上进行微调检查,这些检测器可以恢复失手并去除重复或错配的检测. 文 [6] 验证双子座 [25] 字幕,由人文审查解决差异. 跨模式的人类抽查发现系统性的注释错误。

blocks.en: Training clip construction. From subtasks that pass quality checks, we build 81-frame clips at 640 × 480 640\times 480 (with adjusted intrinsics), each uniformly resampled from a contiguous source interval. A language model [ 25 ] merges the keyframe captions within a window into one window-level caption. Each clip provides synchronized RGB, projected skeletons, camera parameters, and a caption (a default caption is used for the small fraction of robot windows that lack a generated one), plus wide-FOV skeletons and wrist poses where available, in a format shared across human and robot data.
blocks.zh: 培训剪辑建设. 从通过质量检查的子任务中,我们以640×480 640\times 480(有调整的内在内容)搭建了81帧的剪辑,每个剪辑都统一从相接的源间隔被重印. 一个语言模型[25]将窗口内键框标题合并为一个窗口级标题. 每个片段都提供同步的RGB,投影骨架,相机参数,以及一个标题(对于缺乏所生成的机器人窗口的一小部分使用默认标题),外加宽FOV骨架和手腕外形(如果有的话),采用人类和机器人数据共享的格式.

blocks.en: Ropedia W0 combines a unified kinematic control interface with a video diffusion model for cross-embodiment egocentric loco-manipulation prediction (Fig. 4 ). The interface jointly captures viewpoint changes and manipulation through camera poses and projected skeletons, allowing human and robot motion to share a common visual format while preserving embodiment-specific geometry. We first formulate the prediction task and introduce a shared representation of camera and manipulator motion (Sec. 4.1 ). We then describe the conditioning architecture (Sec. 4.2 ), training recipe (Sec. 4.3 ), and distillation (Sec. 4.4 ).

blocks.en: 5 Xp-Teleop
blocks.zh: 5 Xp 调取

blocks.en: Xp-Teleop is a humanoid teleoperation benchmark for evaluating long-horizon prediction during locomotion and dexterous manipulation. It comprises 27 long-horizon takes (about one hour of egocentric video at 30 fps) recorded on a Unitree G1 humanoid with two six-DoF dexterous hands through a whole-body teleoperation rig assembled from off-the-shelf hardware and Unitree’s open-source framework [ 104 ] . Two operators drive locomotion and manipulation concurrently, so walking and dexterous interaction occur within the same take. Every take is recorded with synchronized RGB-D, camera poses, projected skeletons, robot states, language, tactile, and head-IMU signals in the same schema as Xp-Data, and is divided into 543 human-annotated atomic segments spanning 30 skill classes (median 18 segments per take). We keep failed grasps and recoveries so that the benchmark also probes whether a world model can simulate off-nominal outcomes, not only successful executions.
blocks.zh: Xp-Teleop是用于在运动和自控操纵期间评价长视距预测的人体远程操作基准. 它包含27个长视距(大约一个小时的以自负为心的视频在30英尺处), 记录在一个Unitree G1人相上, 两个操作员同时驱动运动和操纵,所以行走和自相矛盾的相互作用都发生在同一项内. 每张相机都以同步的RGB-D,相机姿势,投影骨架,机器人状态,语言,触觉,和头-IMU的信号被录入与Xp-Data相同的图案中,并被分为543个人类附加说明的原子段,跨越了30个技能类(中间为每取18个段). 我们保持失败的把握和恢复,以便基准也探究世界模型是否能够模拟非名义结果,而不仅仅是成功的处决。

blocks.en: 6.1 Setup
blocks.zh: 6.1 设置

blocks.en: We report visual quality with PSNR, SSIM [ 116 ] , and LPIPS [ 134 ] . For benchmarks with camera motion we additionally evaluate camera-trajectory accuracy on poses recovered from the generated video, namely absolute trajectory error (ATE), relative pose error (RPE), and relative rotation error (RRE), as well as hand-following accuracy via keypoint PCK@0.1 (PCKm on matched hands, with detection rate Det). Where noted, we also report video-quality metrics (VBench [ 51 ] subject/background consistency, dynamic degree, and aesthetic quality) and FVD [ 106 ] . Full metric definitions and the per-benchmark evaluation protocol are given in Sec. C.1 .
blocks.zh: 我们用PSNR、SSIM[116]和LPIPS[134]报告视觉质量。 对于有相机运动的基准,我们额外评价了从生成的视频中恢复的布局上的相机-弹射精度,即绝对轨迹出错(ATE)、相对出错(RPE)和相对自转出错(RRE),以及通过键点PCK@0.1(相配手上PCKm,检测率为Det)手接精度。 在注意到的地方,我们还报告了视频质量衡量标准(Bench [51] 主题/背景一致性、动态程度和美学质量)和FVD[106]。 完整的计量定义和每个基准的评价协议见Sec.C.1。

blocks.en:
For each benchmark, we evaluate three adaptation settings: no post-training (direct transfer), few-shot post-training using a small number of episodes per training task, and full-data post-training using the entire training split.
Throughout, zero-shot (equivalently no post-training / direct transfer) means the model is evaluated on a target dataset it was never trained on. The target embodiment may still appear in the multi-embodiment mid-training mixture through other datasets, but the target evaluation dataset itself is never used for training. “Seen” vs. “unseen” splits within a benchmark refer to seen vs. held-out tasks/scenes of that benchmark, not to the embodiment.
We evaluate both training stages of Ropedia W0: pretrain rows are initialized from the human-only pre-training stage, and midtrain rows from the subsequent mid-training stage that mixes human and multi-embodiment robot data.
Checkpoints are always selected on a held-out validation split, never on the benchmark itself.
blocks.zh:
就每个基准而言,我们评价三个适应环境:没有培训后(直接转移),很少使用每个培训任务的少量节目进行射击后培训,以及使用整个培训分开的完整数据后培训。
在整个过程中,零发(相当于没有训练后/直接转移)意味着该模型在它从未受过训练的目标数据集上得到评价. 目标体现可能仍然通过其他数据集出现在多形式中级培训混合物中,但目标评价数据集本身从未用于培训。 “所见”与“所见”在基准内相分,是指所见与该基准被搁置的任务/场景,而不是该基准的体现。
我们评价了Ropedia W0的两种训练阶段:预训排从仅人预训阶段开始初始化,而后中训阶段的中训排则混合了人和多表现机器人数据.
检查点总是通过搁置的验证分拆来选择,从不选择基准本身.

blocks.en:
We compare against generalist robot world models with different action interfaces:
DreamDojo (2B and 14B), which conditions on continuous latent actions pretrained from large-scale human video, and
Cosmos3 (Nano, 16B; Super, 64B), which treats action as a first-class modality with per-domain action encoders.
On the egocentric human-video and AgiBot benchmarks we additionally report two recent action-conditioned world models where available, OSCAR [ 119 ] and RynnWorld-Teleop [ 136 ] .
For data-efficiency comparisons, we additionally post-train the same architecture as ours initialized from the public video-generation weights (“official base”), isolating the contribution of our pre-training.
All baselines are post-trained with their official recipes.
blocks.zh:
我们比较通用机器人世界模型 不同的动作界面:
DreamDojo(2B和14B),它规定了持续潜在行动的条件,预先从大规模人类视频中训练出来,以及
宇宙3号 (Nano, 16B; Super, 64B),它把动作作为一等模式,每个域的动作编码器.
关于以自我为中心的人类影视和AgiBot基准,我们另外报告了最近两个具备行动条件的世界模式,即OSCAR[119]和RynnWorld-Teleop[136]。
为了进行数据效率比较,我们还在培训后从公共视频生成权重(“官方基础”)中初始化了同样的结构,孤立了我们前期培训的贡献。
所有基线都经过了正式的食谱培训。

blocks.en: Human egocentric video. We evaluate on 200 clips from EgoSuite [ 68 ] and OpenAoE [ 66 ] , two datasets unseen during training by both Ropedia W0 and all compared methods. Ropedia W0 achieves the lowest camera-trajectory errors, the highest hand-following accuracy, and the best visual quality (PSNR, SSIM, LPIPS) (Table 2 ). These results demonstrate strong generalization to unseen human egocentric datasets, in both motion following and visual quality.

A single midtrain checkpoint predicts all eight embodiments on the cross-embodiment set with no post-training on these evaluation datasets ( zero-shot ; the embodiments appear in mid-training only through other datasets), reaching 19.83 PSNR at 5B and 21.98 at A14B (Table S6 ). blocks.en: 6.3 Ablation Studies and Analysis
blocks.zh: 6.3 研究与分析

blocks.en: Effectiveness of control conditions. We train separate variants without skeleton or camera conditioning and evaluate them on the cross-embodiment set (Table S6 ). Removing skeleton conditioning reduces PSNR by 3.8/1.8 dB for A14B/5B, respectively, highlighting its importance for visual fidelity. Removing camera conditioning yields smaller average drops of 0.3/0.1 dB, as six of the eight embodiments exhibit little camera motion. On the embodiments with moving viewpoints, however, removing camera conditioning reduces PSNR by 1.3 dB and leads to less generated motion. These results demonstrate the complementary roles of the two control conditions, with camera conditioning particularly important for loco-manipulation.
blocks.zh: 控制条件的有效性。 我们训练没有骨架或相机调节的分化变体,并在交叉化组(表S6)上加以评价。 切除骨架能将A14B/5B的PSNR分别减少3.8/1.8分贝,凸显出其对视觉忠诚的重要性. 取出相机的调制平均降幅较小,为0.3/0.1分贝,因为8个浮雕中的6个显示相机运动不大。 然而,在有动视的浮雕上,取出相机的调制会使PSNR减少1.3分贝并导致生成的运动较少. 这些结果显示了两个控制条件的互补作用,相机的调节对机外操纵尤为重要.

blocks.en: Human pre-training and scaling. To isolate the effect of our pre-training, we post-train the same architecture initialized from either public video-generation weights (“official base”) or our pretrained weights (Table S7 ). With 1% of the post-training data, Ropedia W0 5B improves PSNR by 4.8/7.1/6.6 dB over the official base and already outperforms the official base post-trained on 100% of the data. It retains an approximately 2.3 dB advantage under full-data post-training. The gains are largest in the low-data regime and remain substantial under full-data post-training. Prediction quality also improves as we scale the amount of human-video pre-training data, showing a consistent, monotonic improvement on held-out human video (Fig. 6 ), in human-to-robot transfer to Ψ 0 \Psi_{0} , Xp-Teleop, and ω \omega -HOME (Fig. 7 ), and on the DreamDojo GR-1 cross-evaluation sets (Fig. 8 ); see Sec. C.2 for the scaling protocol.

blocks.en: Model scaling. Beyond data, increasing the model from 5B to A14B improves prediction consistently across every regime: + 2.2 +2.2 dB PSNR on the cross-embodiment set ( → 21.98 19.83\!\to\!21.98 , Table S6 ), + 2.3 +2.3 dB in-distribution on AgiBot ( → 20.88 18.60\!\to\!20.88 , Table 5 ), and, without any post-training, + 2.1 / 1.7 / 1.4 +2.1/1.7/1.4 dB on Ψ 0 \Psi_{0} / ω \omega -HOME/Xp-Teleop (Table 4 ). Model-size and data scaling are thus complementary, jointly driving the gains reported above.

Distillation. The distilled 4-step 5B student reaches 21.3 fps on a single GPU ( 7 × 7\times the 50-step teacher, past the 20 fps real-time line), while matching the teacher’s fidelity from short clips (6.3 s) out to minute-long rollouts (Table S1 ; Sec. B.2 ).

blocks.en: 6.4 Downstream Applications
blocks.zh: 6.4 下游应用

blocks.en: We study four downstream uses of Ropedia W0, spanning simulation and real robots: policy evaluation, model-based planning, world–action modeling, and live teleoperation.
blocks.zh: 我们研究了Ropedia W0的四种下游用途,包括模拟和真正的机器人:政策评估、基于模型的规划、世界-行动模型制作和实时远程操作。

blocks.en: Policy evaluation. Used as a proxy environment, Ropedia W0 evaluates policy rollouts using a task-progress rubric following WorldEval [ 64 ] and SIMPLER [ 62 ] . Its scores closely match ground-truth evaluations, achieving Pearson correlations of r = 0.984 r=0.984 across five π 0.5 \pi_{0.5} [ 52 ] checkpoints in RoboTwin 2.0 [ 23 ] and r = 0.996 r=0.996 across three Ψ 0 \Psi_{0} checkpoints and an expert-teleoperation reference on a real Unitree G1 loco-manipulation task. Both evaluations yield MMRV = 0 =0 and preserve the ground-truth checkpoint rankings (Fig. 9 (a,b)), supporting the use of Ropedia W0 for policy comparison and checkpoint selection.
blocks.zh: 政策评价。 Ropedia W0作为代用环境,使用WorldEval [64] 和SIMPLER [62] 之后的任务进度标题评价政策推出。 其得分与地面实况评价密切相匹配,在RoboTwin 2.0 [23] 的5个检查站中,皮尔逊的比值为:0.984 r=0.984 r=0.984;在RoboTwin 2.0 [23] 的检查站中,比值为:0.996 r=0.996;在实际的Unitree G1 Loco-manuation任务中,比值为:0.984 r=0.986。 两次评价都得出了MMRV=0=0,并保留了地面真实检查站排名(图9(a),b),支持使用Ropedia W0进行政策比较和选择检查站。

blocks.en: Model-based planning. Following DreamDojo [ 34 ] , Ropedia W0 is used for closed-loop planning: it rolls out multiple candidate action sequences, an external value model scores the predicted rollouts, and the selected plan is executed in the environment. We evaluate planning on fixed-view manipulation tasks in simulation and on the real robot. The executed plan reaches 92% task progress vs. 53% (random selection) / 85% (best fixed checkpoint) in RoboTwin 2.0, and 55% vs. 26% / 45% on the real G1 (Fig. 9 (c,d)).
blocks.zh: 基于模式的规划。 追随"梦之道" [34],罗佩地亚. W0用于闭路规划:它推出多个候选动作序列,一个外值模型对所预测的展开进行评分,选定的计划在环境中执行. 我们评价模拟中的固定视图操纵任务和真正的机器人的规划。 在RoboTwin 2.0中,任务进度达到92%对53%(随机选择)/85%(最佳固定检查站),在真正的G1中,任务进度达到55%对26%/45%(图9(c,d))。

blocks.en: World–action modeling. A world–action model jointly predicts future frames and the actions that produce them, so a stronger world model should be a better initialization. We test this by initializing the video backbone of FastWAM [ 131 ] from our pretrained 5B world model and leaving its action head and training recipe unchanged. This improves action learning: trained on LIBERO [ 71 ] and evaluated directly on both LIBERO and the held-out LIBERO-Plus [ 32 ] , it raises LIBERO-Plus success from 50.06% to 56.82% and improves every few-shot setting (Table 6 ), and on a real G1 loco-manipulation task it reaches 56.7% task progress vs. 33.3% for FastWAM, competitive with the Ψ 0 \Psi_{0} VLA policy itself (50.0%; Fig. 10 ).
blocks.zh: 世界行动模式。 世界行动模式共同预测未来框架和产生这些框架的行动,因此更强大的世界模式应该是更好的初始化。 我们通过将FastWAM[131]的视频骨干从我们经过预先训练的5B世界模型中初始化来测试这一点,并保持其行动头目和训练配方不变. 这改进了行动学习:在LIBERO[71]方面接受培训并直接在LIBERO和被搁置的LIBERO-Plus[32]方面进行评价,将LIBERO-Plus的成功率从50.06%提高到56.82%并改进了每几发的设定(表6),在真正的G1遥控任务上,它达到了56.7%的任务进度,对FastWAM来说达到了33.3%的任务进度,与 \\Psi\0}VLA政策本身竞争(50.0%;图10))。

blocks.en: 7 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 7 结论

blocks.en: We presented Ropedia W0, a unified egocentric world model for loco-manipulation across humans and robots with grippers or dexterous hands. Its explicit kinematic representation combines camera poses for viewpoint motion with projected skeletons for manipulation, preserving embodiment-native geometry within a shared visual format. This interface enables learning from human and robot data and remains consistent from pre-training to post-training. Trained on Xp-Data with 10k hours of human video and 3k hours of robot data, Ropedia W0 demonstrates strong zero-shot generalization, data-efficient adaptation, and competitive prediction across diverse benchmarks, including our new Xp-Teleop. Our scaling analysis further shows that increasing human-video pre-training improves prediction on held-out human video and transfer to robot benchmarks, highlighting human experience as a scalable source of supervision for cross-embodiment world modeling. Beyond video prediction, the model supports policy evaluation, model-based planning, and world–action modeling, while distillation enables real-time interactive simulation.
blocks.zh: 我们提出了Ropedia W0, 一种统一的自我中心世界模型, 用于在人类和机器人之间用握手或手作手作手作脚。 其明显的动能表现结合了相机呈现的视线运动和用于操纵的投影骨架,在共同的视觉格式中保留了内在几何图形. 这一接口能够学习人类和机器人数据,并保持从培训前到培训后的一致性。 Ropedia W0在Xp-Data上接受了10k小时的人类视频和3k小时的机器人数据培训,展现出强烈的零镜头通化,数据高效的适应,以及跨不同基准的竞争性预测,包括我们新的Xp-Teleop. 我们的缩放分析进一步表明,增加人影预训可以改进对被搁置的人类视频的预测并转而使用机器人基准,强调人类经验是跨表现世界建模的可扩展监督来源。 除了视频预测外,该模型还支持政策评价、基于模型的规划以及世界行动模型,而蒸馏则能够实现实时交互模拟。

blocks.en: The benchmark overview (Fig. 5 ) and the dataset comparison (Table 1 ) appear in the main text (Sec. 5 ); here we provide the full rig, control, recording, and comparison details.
blocks.zh: 基准概览(图5)和数据集比较(表1)见正文(第5节);这里我们提供了完整的钻机、控制、记录和比较细节。

blocks.en:
A Unitree G1 humanoid with 29 actuated degrees of freedom is equipped with two Inspire RH56DFX dexterous hands, each with six actuated degrees of freedom.
An Azure Kinect DK mounted on a custom 3D-printed helmet rigidly attached to the robot’s head records the egocentric RGB-D view.
Because the G1 has no actuated neck joints, the camera moves only with the waist and mobile base, matching the motion represented by our camera-pose control channel (Sec. 4 ).
blocks.zh:
一个有29个活性自由度的Unitree G1人造相,配备有两只Inspire RH56DFX分叉手,每只手有6个活性自由度.
Azure Kinect DK安装在定制的3D打印头盔上,
由于G1没有起动的颈关节,相机只用腰部和移动基部来移动,相机与以相机-相机控制通道(Sec. 4)为代表的运动相匹配.

blocks.en:
Two operators control the robot concurrently, allowing locomotion and manipulation to occur within the same take.
The manipulation operator wears a Meta Quest 3, whose controller-free hand tracking provides targets to a Pinocchio-based inverse-kinematics solver for the two 7-DoF arms and to a dexterous-hand retargeting module.
The locomotion operator independently commands the robot’s base velocity using Unitree’s R3 remote.
blocks.zh:
两个操作员同时控制了机器人,允许同一摄取范围内发生运动和操纵.
操控操作员穿戴了Meta Quest 3,其无控制手跟踪为两个7-DoF臂上以平诺克奇为主的反相解析器提供目标并给一个可调取手重定向模块.
运动操作员使用Unitree的R3遥控器独立指挥机器人的基数速度.

blocks.en:
Each take records the robot and hand joint states, commanded targets, R3 commands, headset tracking, and Kinect stream on a common clock.
From these signals, we derive the two action channels described in Sec. 4 : camera poses and hand skeletons.
The hand skeletons are computed through forward kinematics and projected into the image using the calibrated helmet-to-camera extrinsics.
We retain every take initiated by the operators, including failed grasps and subsequent recoveries, because Xp-Teleop is intended to evaluate whether a world model can simulate off-nominal outcomes as well as successful executions.
blocks.zh:
每个都记录机器人和手联合状态,指挥目标,R3指令,耳机跟踪,以及一个常见的时钟上的Kinect流.
从这些信号中,我们得出第4节所描述的两个动作道:相机姿势和手骨架.
手骨架通过前向运动来计算,并使用被校准的头盔到相机外向投影。
由于Xp-Teleop旨在评估一个世界模型是否能够模拟非名义结果以及成功处决,因此我们保留了操作者发起的每起行动,包括失败的把握和随后的恢复。

blocks.en:
Xp-Teleop contains 27 long-horizon teleoperation takes, totaling approximately one hour of egocentric video recorded at 30 fps.
The takes are divided into 543 human-annotated atomic segments, with each take containing between 8 and 42 segments (median 18).
This annotation is substantially finer-grained than the common convention of assigning a single instruction to an entire episode.
The resulting segments cover 30 skill classes.
The segment captions also identify the manipulated objects and describe the temporal progression of each task, providing language supervision aligned with the recorded observations and actions.
blocks.zh:
Xp-Teleop包含27个长视距的远程操作,总共大约一个小时的以自负为中心录制的视频在了30英尺的高度.
摄取分为543个人类附加说明的原子片段,每个片段包含8到42个片段(中间18个).
这一注释大大优于为整个剧集分配单一指令的普通惯例。
由此产生的部分包括30个技能课程。
片段标题还识别被操纵的对象并描述每项任务的时间进展,提供与所记录的观察和行动相匹配的语言监督.

blocks.en:
Table 1 compares publicly described dexterous-humanoid teleoperation datasets in terms of robot capabilities, task horizon, and available recording modalities.
We divide the datasets into two groups according to how the lower body is used during data collection.
In the tabletop-teleoperation group, the robot’s legs remain locked even if the release provides base commands or whole-body state.
In the loco-manipulation group, locomotion is actively commanded and can occur within the same episode as manipulation.
blocks.zh:
表1从机器人能力、任务范围以及现有记录方式等角度比较了公开描述的德氏-人文远程操作数据集。
我们根据数据收集过程中下体的使用方式,将数据集分为两组.
在平面-远程操作组中,机器人的腿仍然被锁住,即使释放提供了基础指令或全身状态.
在机能操控组中,机能操控被积极指挥,可以在与操控相同的一集内发生.

blocks.en: The three task-horizon columns report episode-level means over the analyzed portion of each dataset. Duration is the wall-clock length of one episode, computed as the number of recorded frames divided by the dataset’s frame rate (30 Hz for all datasets except GR00T-Teleop, 20 Hz). Frame counts are taken from each dataset’s own metadata. For our dataset we report the released task windows, not the raw recordings. RoboMIND does not document its frame rate; we assume 30 Hz.
blocks.zh: 三个任务范围栏目报告各集的级别意味着每个数据集分析的部分。 持续时间是一集的墙上时钟长度,按记录帧数除以数据集帧率(除GR00T-Teleop,20Hz外的所有数据集30Hz)来计算. 框架计数取自每个数据集自己的元数据。 对于我们的数据集,我们报告 释放的任务窗口,而不是原始录音。 RoboMIND不记录其帧率;我们假设是30赫兹.

blocks.en: Loco. Range measures how much space an episode covers. For each episode we take the 3-D position trajectory of the robot base (or, when only a camera trajectory is available, the head camera), compute its axis-aligned bounding box, and report the box diagonal in metres. We use the bounding-box diagonal rather than integrated path length, because path length at 30 Hz is dominated by body sway and pose-estimation jitter (on our data it inflates the value by roughly 7 × \times ).
blocks.zh: Loco. 测距测量每集覆盖多少空间. 每集我们取出机器人基地的三维位置轨迹(或者,当只有相机轨迹时,取出头相机),计算出其轴相接的相接相框,并报告相框对角以米为单位. 我们使用边框对角线而不是集成路径长度,因为30赫兹的路径长度以身体摇摆和姿势-估计快活为主(根据我们的数据,它将数值夸大了大约7×\时)。

blocks.en: Pose sources. Ours: visual-inertial SLAM (metric). Humanoid-Everyday: on-board odometry. UnifoLM-WBT (new schema): the robot state estimator’s base pose. All other datasets provide no metric base pose; we run DA3-Streaming with its metric configuration on the egocentric video (10 fps, 504 px input) to obtain camera poses. Because monocular metric SLAM has a systematic scale error, we calibrate it once against ground truth: on the 879 Humanoid-Everyday locomotion episodes the DA3 box diagonal exceeds the odometry value by a median factor of 1.39 (IQR 1.28–1.55), and on our 27 episodes the median factor against SLAM is 1.03; we divide all DA3-derived values by the pooled median 1.39. After calibration the estimator reproduces ground truth within 10% on both datasets (ours 1.48 vs 1.61 m; Humanoid-Everyday 0.84 vs 0.82 m). For AgiBot-Beta we estimate on a length-stratified sample of 30 episodes. Unitree G1 Dex1/Dex3, PH2D, and RoboMIND Tien Kung are reported as 0.
blocks.zh: Pose来源. 我们的:视觉-惯性 SLAM (度量). 人气-"天天":上机平面. UnifoLM-WBT(新计划):机器人状态估计器的基础姿势. 所有其他数据集都没有提供度量基准姿势;我们运行DA3-Streaming,在以自我为中心的视频上带有度量配置(10英尺,504px输入)以获得相机姿势. 由于单体指标SLAM有系统尺度误差,我们对照地面真理校正过一次:在879人-每日运动事件上,DA3箱对角线超过Odometry值的中位系数为1.39(IQR 1.28-1.55),在我们27个事件上,SLAM的中位系数为1.03;我们把所有DA3衍生值除以集合中位数1.39。 在校正后,估计器在两个数据集的10%范围内复制地面真理(我们的1.48对1.61米;Humanoid-Everyday 0.84对0.82米)。 对于AgiBot-Beta,我们估计有30集的长度样本。 据报道,Unitree G1 Dex1/Dex3,PH2D,和RoboMIND Tien Kung为0.

blocks.en: Subtasks counts how many sequential sub-goals an episode’s task instruction specifies. We apply one rule to every dataset: the instruction is lower-cased and split into clauses at commas, semicolons, periods and the connectives "and", "then", "until", "upon", "after"; a clause counts as one subtask if its first or second content word is an action verb from a fixed list (pick, place, put, take, grasp, carry, walk, go, enter, turn, open, close, push, pull, pour, wipe, fold, locate, find, hang, press, insert, …). Locomotion clauses count the same as manipulation clauses. Every instruction counts at least 1. Instruction sources: the per-episode task string for LeRobot datasets, the HDF5 description attribute for PH2D and RoboMIND, the task name for ω \omega -HOME, and the human-written task instruction of each take for our dataset (one 19-step instruction excluded as an outlier). AgiBot-Beta ships no instruction text. Because subtask boundaries follow the wording and granularity of each release’s instructions, this count is an annotation-level measure of task horizon rather than a platform-independent action count.
blocks.zh: 子任务计算一集任务指示所指定的多少相继的子目标. 我们在每个数据集中应用一条规则: 指令在逗号,分号,时段和连接符"和","到","到","到","到"; 如果其第一或第二内容单词是固定列表中的动作动词(挑出,放入,接入,接入,接入,接入,转出,打开,关闭,推入,倒入,倒入,擦出,折出,定位,找出,挂出,按出,插入. 休息条款与操纵条款相同。 每个指令至少都算数 1. 指令源:LeRobot数据集的每集任务字符串,PH2D和RoboMIND的HDF5描述属性,QQ\omega - HOME的任务名称,以及每集我们数据集的人写任务指令(一个19步指令被排除为外接符). AgiBot-Beta号没有指令文本。 因为子任务边界遵循每个发布指令的措辞和颗粒性,所以这个计数是任务视野的注释级度量,而不是平台独立的动作计数.

blocks.en:
The modality columns describe information available in the analyzed dataset release. For Kpts. , we also count image-space keypoints that can be reconstructed from released joint states and camera calibration using a publicly available URDF. RGB@fps reports the resolution and frame rate of the principal egocentric RGB stream. Dpt. requires a usable released depth stream; placeholder or zero-filled channels do not qualify. IMU requires explicit inertial-sensor measurements.
Estimated root poses, torso poses, or camera trajectories alone are not counted as IMU data. Tac. denotes released tactile measurements.
blocks.zh:
模式栏描述分析数据集释放中的信息。 对于 Kpts. 我们也计算出图像空间的键点,这些键点可以使用公开的URDF从释放的联合状态和相机校正中重建出. RGB@fps报告主要自负RGB流的分辨率和帧率. Dpt. 需要可用的释放出深度流; 占位符或零填充通道不合格. IMU需要明确的惯性传感器测量.
估计的根起、躯干起或相机轨迹本身不作为IMU数据计算。 Tac.表示释放出触觉测量.

blocks.en:
WB joints requires recorded joint states covering both the upper and lower body, including the legs.
Arm-only or hand-only states, estimated root or torso poses, and commanded base velocities do not satisfy this criterion.
This column describes the coverage of the recorded state and does not require the leg joints to exhibit substantial motion during the released episodes.
Consequently, a dataset may provide whole-body joint states while still belonging to the tabletop group.
blocks.zh:
世行关节需要有记录的关节状态,覆盖上下身体,包括腿部.
仅指臂或只指手的状态,估计的根状或躯干状,以及指挥的基速度不符合这个标准.
本栏介绍所收录的状态的覆盖情况,不要求腿关节在放出片段时表现出实质性运动.
因此,数据集在仍属于桌面组的同时,可以提供全身联合状态。

blocks.en:
Cal. requires sufficient camera calibration to relate robot kinematics to the image observations, including both camera intrinsics and the relevant extrinsics.
Camera trajectories or extrinsics provided without intrinsics do not satisfy this criterion.
blocks.zh:
Cal.需要足够的相机校正来将机器人动能与图像观测联系起来,包括相机内在和相机相关的外相.
没有内在内容的相机轨迹或外接装置不符合这一标准。

blocks.en: Kpts. denotes temporally aligned image-space keypoints, either provided directly or obtainable by projecting the relevant robot kinematics using released joint states, sufficient camera calibration, and a publicly available URDF.
blocks.zh: Kpts. 表示时间对齐的图像-空间密钥点,通过使用释放的联合状态投射相关机器人动能,充足的相机校正,以及公开的URDF,直接提供或获取.

blocks.en:
For Unitree Dex1, whole-body joint states are available only in the v3 release; v2 provides arm and gripper states but not the corresponding lower-body joint states.
Although v3 supports base commands, the observed variation of its leg joints is below 0.03 rad in the analyzed recordings.
We therefore treat its measured locomotion range as zero and place it in the tabletop group.
blocks.zh:
对于Unitree Dex1,全体联合状态仅在v3发行中提供;v2提供手臂和抓取状态,但不提供相应的下体联合状态.
虽然v3支持基础指令,但其腿关节被观察到的变异在被分析的录音中低于0.03 rad.
因此,我们将其测量到的运动范围定为0,并将其放入桌面组。

Its released depth channel is zero-filled and is therefore not counted as usable depth.

Humanoid Everyday task-horizon statistics are computed from its loco-manipulation subset, and its tactile measurements are available only for the G1/Dex3 embodiment.

blocks.en: Appendix B Model and Implementation Details
blocks.zh: 附录B 模式和执行细节

blocks.en: This section describes the video backbones, distillation and interactive inference, and the optional wide-FOV skeleton-conditioning branch. Figures and measurements are grouped with the component they illustrate.
blocks.zh: 本节介绍视频主干线,蒸馏和交互推论,以及可选的广FOV骨架空调分支. 数字和计量按它们所说明的组成部分分类。

blocks.en: B.1 Backbone and Conditioning
blocks.zh: B.1 后骨和条件

blocks.en: Ropedia W0 predicts future egocentric video from an initial visual observation and factorized camera and manipulator controls (Sec. 4.1 ). The following details describe the pretrained backbones used by this shared conditioning interface.
blocks.zh: 罗佩迪亚 W0通过初步的视觉观察和分解相机和操纵器控制(Sec 4.1. 以下详细介绍此共享调制接口使用的预训骨干.

blocks.en: We instantiate Ropedia W0 at two scales using the Wan2.2 family of pretrained video diffusion models [ 108 ] . Wan2.2-TI2V-5B uses a dense diffusion transformer with approximately 5B parameters. Wan2.2-I2V-A14B uses two experts specialized for different noise regimes: a high-noise expert and a low-noise expert. Only one expert is active at each denoising step, yielding approximately 14B active parameters. In our experiments, the two experts are adapted separately and used in their respective noise regimes during inference.
blocks.zh: 使用Wan2.2家族的预训视频传播模型[108], Wan2.2-TI2V-5B采用密度扩散变压器,参数约为5B. Wan2.2-I2V-A14B使用两名专门研究不同噪声系统的专家:一名高噪声专家和一名低噪声专家. 只有一名专家活跃在每一个解密步骤,得出大约14B活性参数。 在我们的实验中,两位专家在推论中被分别改编并被分别用于各自的噪声系统.

blocks.en: Both backbones operate on spatiotemporal latents produced by a video VAE and follow the diffusion transformer architecture [ 90 ] . Text embeddings are incorporated through cross-attention, while sinusoidal timestep embeddings provide adaptive normalization and residual modulation within each transformer block. We train them with the latent flow-matching objective [ 70 ] : the video VAE encodes each clip into latents, the first temporal latent is retained as clean visual context, and noise and the loss are applied only to future latents. The camera-ray and skeleton conditioning branches introduced in Sec. 4.2 augment these backbones through zero-initialized projections, preserving the pretrained model’s behavior at initialization.
blocks.zh: 两种骨干都使用由视频VAE所制作的spatiotemporal潜想来操作,并遵循扩散变压器架构 [90]. 文字嵌入是通过交叉意向而成的,而鼻音时步嵌入则在每个变压器块内提供适应性常态和剩余调制. 我们以潜在的流量匹配目标训练他们: 视频VAE将每个片段编码为潜伏,第一个时间潜伏被保留为干净的视觉上下文,噪音和损失仅适用于未来潜伏. Sec.4.2中引入的相机射线和骨架调节分支通过零初始化的预测来增强这些骨干,在初始化时保留了被预先训练的模型的行为.

blocks.en: B.2 Distillation and Interactive Simulation
blocks.zh: B.2 稀释和互动模拟

blocks.en: We first obtain a 4-step autoregressive generator using Causal Forcing [ 144 , 137 ] , then extend it to long-video streaming using LongLive [ 125 ] , retaining camera–skeleton conditioning.
blocks.zh: 我们首先使用 Causal Forcing [144, 137] 获得一个四相自递式发电机, 然后使用 LongLive [125] 扩展为长相机流线, 保留相机-skeleton 调制.

blocks.en: Few-step distillation. An autoregressive diffusion model provides causal initialization. Asymmetric DMD then trains the causal generator using a frozen bidirectional real-score teacher (with classifier-free guidance) and an online bidirectional fake-score model. The generator starts from the causal initialization, while both score networks initialize from the bidirectional camera–skeleton model. The fake-score model learns a denoising objective on generated samples.
blocks.zh: 少步分出分出. 自动回向扩散模型提供因果初始化. 不对称 DMD 然后使用被冻结的双向真分数老师(带有无分级指导)和在线双向假分数模型来训练因果生成器. 生成器从因果初始化开始,而两个分数网络则从双向相机-skeleton模型初始化. 假分数模型在生成的样本上学习了去名分目标.

blocks.en: Long-video extension. LongLive adapts the few-step generator for streaming with within-block bidirectional and cross-block causal attention. A bounded KV cache retains a local window and an attention sink.
blocks.zh: 长相相续. LongLive改造了几步生成器来进行流出,并有区块内双向和跨区块的因果关系. 被捆绑的 KV 缓存保留了本地窗口和注意力槽.

blocks.en: Figure S5 illustrates distillation; Fig. S6 shows subsequent long-video streaming.
blocks.zh: 图S5显示了蒸馏;图S6显示了随后的长视频流.

blocks.en:
Figure S5: Distillation of Ropedia W0 into a few-step causal student. Top: causal distillation initializes the few-step autoregressive generator.
Bottom: asymmetric DMD updates the causal generator G θ G_{\theta} using a frozen bidirectional real-score teacher and an online-trained bidirectional fake-score model. The diagram illustrates the A14B MoE backbone; the 5B model follows an analogous procedure with a dense backbone. LongLive subsequently extends the few-step model for long-video streaming (Fig. S6 ).
blocks.zh:
图S5:罗佩迪亚蒸发 W0入数步因子生. 顶部:因果分馏初始化了几步自递式生成器.
下部:不对称 DMD 更新了因果发生器 G QQQTHETA 使用被冻结的双向真分数老师和在线训练的双向假分数模型. 该图显示了A14B MOE主干线;5B模型遵循了类似程序并具有密集主干线. LongLive随后为长相相声流线(图S6.

blocks.en: On a single GPU at 640 × 480 640\times 480 , the 4-step student generates a 125-frame clip in about 2 s of autoregressive generation and about 6 s including VAE decoding ( ≈ \approx 21 fps), compared with about 41 s for the 50-step teacher (a 7 × 7\times end-to-end speed-up), and streams its first block within roughly 1.4 s.
blocks.zh: 在640×480 640\times 480的单个GPU上,4步学生在大约2 s的自旋生成中生成125帧剪辑,约6 s包括了VAE解码(QQ\约21 fps),而50步老师(一个7×7\times end-to-end speed-up)大约为41 s,而它的首个区块大约在1.4 s以内.

blocks.en: Figure S6 illustrates the streaming rollout mechanism; Table S1 reports quality and throughput across rollout lengths.
blocks.zh: 图S6说明了流出推出机制;表S1报告流出期间的质量和吞吐量。

blocks.en: Figure S6: LongLive-based streaming with the distilled student. Successive segments reuse the previously generated visual context while accepting updated controls (skeleton, camera trajectory, and text). Each block is produced by the few-step causal student, so the per-segment cost is bounded while retained context carries information across segments, enabling real-time long-horizon rollout.

blocks.en: Clips contain 81 frames at 640 × 480 640\times 480 and 16 fps. Methods receive the same initial frame and, when supported, the same caption, with seed 0. Camera and hand conditions derive from the same camera annotations and projected hand keypoints, converted to each method’s native interface. Each baseline is run under its native conditioning interface: DreamDojo with latent actions, Cosmos3 with joint camera-and-hand conditioning.

blocks.en: ATE is absolute trajectory error after rigid SE(3) alignment without scale fitting; RPE measures stepwise translation error, and RRE measures rotation error relative to the first frame. Camera poses are estimated from generated videos with DA3 [ 69 ] . Hand metrics use MediaPipe [ 79 ] detections at confidence 0.3, matched to projected annotations. PCK@.1 uses a threshold of 10% of the image diagonal and penalizes missed detections; PCKm@.1 evaluates matched hands only, and Det is the detection rate. Cons., Dyn, and Aes denote VBench subject consistency, dynamic degree, and aesthetic quality. FVD 16 uses non-overlapping 16-frame windows, while FVD full uses the full sequences. FVD is recomputed for each evaluation set rather than averaged across datasets.
blocks.zh: ATE是刚性SE(3)对接后绝对轨迹出错而无尺度相配;RPE度量相继翻译出错,而RRE度量旋转出错相对于第一个帧. 相机的外观是用 DA3 [69] 生成的视频来估计的. 手量度使用MediaPipe [79] 在置信度0.3的检测,与预测说明相匹配. PCK@1使用图像对角的10%的阈值,并惩罚被错失的检测;PCKm@1只评价匹配的手,而德特是检测率. Cons., Dyn, and Aes 表示V Bench主题的一致性,动态程度,和美学质量. FVD 16使用非重叠的16个帧窗,而FVD则完全使用完整的序列. 每一套评价均重算FVD,而不是各数据集的平均值。

blocks.en: In the human evaluation tables, ATE and RPE are reported in centimeters, RRE in degrees, HandL2 in pixels, and PSNR in dB. PCK, PCKm, Det, Cons., Dyn, and Aes are reported as percentages; SSIM, LPIPS, and FVD have no physical units.

blocks.en: The scaling figures appear in the main text: held-out human video at hand-detection confidence 0.3 (Fig. 6 ), human-to-robot transfer to Ψ 0 \Psi_{0} /Xp-Teleop/ ω \omega -HOME (Fig. 7 ), and the DreamDojo cross-evaluation sets (Fig. 8 ). We detail the shared protocol here. Each point is a checkpoint taken at the indicated amount of human-video pre-training data (hours of video processed), with the data mixture held fixed. Because training stays within a single epoch, the hours processed at each point equal the amount of unique human data seen, so these curves measure data scaling rather than repeated exposure. For held-out human video the checkpoint is evaluated zero-shot, whereas for the DreamDojo and transfer benchmarks it is post-trained on the target with the same recipe before evaluation.

blocks.en: Appendix F Limitations and Future Work
blocks.zh: 附录F 限制和未来的工作

blocks.en: 1. The distilled student supports real-time, minute-long rollouts (Sec. B.2 ); stronger memory mechanisms or periodic re-grounding are promising directions for extending stable interactive simulation to longer horizons. 2. We study up to a 14B-active model and scale the amount of human-video pre-training data while holding the data mixture fixed; prediction quality improves monotonically with the amount of data (Sec. C.2 ), suggesting that scaling data and model size further, and broadening embodiment and task coverage, are promising directions toward more capable and reliable embodied world models. 3. Our kinematic interface captures camera and manipulator motion but not physical contact or object dynamics; coupling the world model with simulation-ready, physically grounded 3D assets and scenes [ 18 , 19 , 20 ] is a promising direction toward modeling the underlying dynamics rather than only their visual consequences.
